summary: Three-service system: React SPA frontend -> Express REST backend (MongoDB) -> FastAPI AI microservice (Python NLP/OCR).

services.name: frontend
services.role: React 19 SPA (Vite, Tailwind 4, TanStack Query). Role-based portals: Citizen, Volunteer, Department Admin, Super Admin.

services.name: backend
services.role: Express + TypeScript REST API with layered architecture: routes -> controllers -> services -> repositories -> Mongoose models. JWT auth with role middleware, multer uploads, Zod-ish validators, audit middleware.

services.name: ai-service
services.role: FastAPI microservice: OCR (tesseract/OpenCV/PyMuPDF), NLP analysis (spaCy, sentence-transformers, keybert), clustering/similarity, priority prediction, department detection, summary generation.

cross_service_flows: Frontend -> backend REST (/api/v1) with JWT bearer token (axios interceptor in frontend/src/services/api/client.ts)
Backend -> ai-service HTTP calls for complaint analysis (backend/src/services/ai.service.ts)

conventions.frontend_naming: PascalCase components grouped by role under pages/
conventions.ai_service_naming: snake_case modules; controller -> service -> domain package
conventions.tests: pytest in ai-service/tests only; no backend/frontend tests present
